instructions.name: apply_poi
docs: Anyone may apply a scheduled root / gate change after the delay.

accounts.name: source
docs: SOL source: the user wallet that pays the shield.

instructions.name: swap_refund
docs: Refund stays available while swaps are paused so a parked escrow can return to a note.

errors.name: BadFee
errors.msg: Fee is below the unshield floor

errors.name: FeeOnTransfer
errors.msg: Token transfer delivered a different amount

errors.name: BadSwapProgram
errors.msg: Swap program is missing or not allowlisted

errors.name: StaleTree
errors.msg: Tree next_index moved; rebuild insert PDAs

errors.name: BadMint
errors.msg: Mint has a hook, permanent delegate, or other unsafe extension

errors.name: BadSwap
errors.msg: Swap escrow is invalid or hop is not allowlisted

errors.name: BadPoi
errors.msg: Proof of innocence is missing or does not match the association set

errors.name: Timelock
errors.msg: This change is still in its timelock

fields.name: swap_program
docs: Allowlisted hop (Jupiter or the dummy AMM in tests). Default = none.

fields.name: innocence_root
docs: Live association-set root. Markers for this root and `innocence_history` are accepted.

fields.name: poi_required
docs: When set, public unshields and swap prepares need a PoI marker.

types.name: FreezeAllow
docs: Owner-approved mint that may keep a freeze authority (USDC, USDT, and similar).
The issuer can still freeze the vault ATA and lock every note in that token.

types.name: SwapEscrow
docs: Isolated swap escrow. Holds one input mint until execute or refund.
The hop may only sign for this PDA against `escrow_ata`; no other escrow-owned ATAs.
